message: A few days into summer break――early morning.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, everyone's here.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's so hoooot~……」

name: Ririmu
message: 「The wind feels all sticky, super sticky~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Okay, let's start the run！」
The basic training menu doesn't really change whether it's a normal day or summer break.
Let your guard down, and your stamina and muscle strength will inevitably drop by that much. That's why daily accumulation matters.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, don't you think we can skip today……？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「We're going to get heatstroke……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wanna eat shaved ice~！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufufu, you're all welcome to take a break.」

name: Asahi
message: 「While you do, I'll have Teacher Iori give me one-on-one instruction.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？ Like we'd let that slide.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Losing to Asahi pisses me off~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, fine. Then I'll treat everyone to ice cream after the run！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yaaay~！ Alright, let's do our best~~！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Getting baited with ice cream... Setsugekka's so cheap~……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Teacher Muragaki~, Momimomi said she doesn't want ice cream, so I'm gonna eat Momimomi's share too~」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, got it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't screw with me, who said I was giving it up！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Begin！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Everyone, it's a scramble for Momimomi's ice cream~」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm definitely not giving it！」
At the signal, everyone took off running along the perimeter of the academy.
Watching them go――

name: Mikoto
message: 「Phew, they really go at it in this fucking heat……」
From the direction of the school building, Teacher Sasaki strolled over.

name: Iori
message: 「Sasaki-sensei, what brings you out so early in the morning？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah, one of the students got food poisoning. Thanks to that, I'm stuck making house calls first thing in the morning.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「It's supposed to be summer break, and yet I don't get a lick of rest. Being a school nurse is a rotten gig...！」
Sasaki-sensei, grumbling away to herself.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oh, right—speaking of which, I heard, Muragaki.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Heard your 'errand' got extended, huh?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, thankfully, it looks like I'll be able to stay a little longer.」
Apparently, since then, Keisetsu had pulled strings all over the place to force through an extension on my "errand."
Even Company Commander Asagiri had given a wry smile and said, "The only people who could strong-arm the current Chief of Staff are Old Man Suzakuin and Lady Keisetsu."

name: Mikoto
message: 「With your skills, you could even become a full-time teacher at the academy. Why are you so hung up on keeping it an 'errand'？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, out of loyalty, I suppose.」
When all is said and done, I really like everyone in the Tenju Special Forces. I haven't lost the feeling that I want to go back someday.
Besides, whether I'd even keep being a teacher after everyone in the current Takamura Class graduated—I still didn't know.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hmm... Well, you do whatever you want.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Seems like the Kazamine twins and Momiji have settled down too, so Takamura Class should be smooth sailing for a while at least.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, I wonder about that.」
The students of Takamura Class are a whole bunch of problem children. They're bound to stir up some kind of trouble again sooner or later.

name: Mikoto
message: 「In any case, having you as the assistant homeroom teacher for Takamura Class takes a load off my shoulders, so I'm grateful.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「By all means, stay here and lay your bones to rest at Murakumo Academy.」
Sasaki-sensei, flapping her shirt to cool off with a look of utter lethargy on her face.

name: Iori
message: 「Come to think of it, Sasaki-sensei, how did you end up as Takamura Class's homeroom teacher in the first place？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Huh...？ Didn't I tell you before？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「A while back, I went for a little fly through the sky to buy some inari sushi, and as luck would have it, the folks from the Spirit Agency spotted me.」
W-Went for a little fly through the sky...？！

name: Mikoto
message: 「Things were about to get real messy, so Masatane managed to sweep it under the rug.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「And Masatane was steaming mad about it, too. Claimed it was my punishment and dumped Takamura Class onto my lap.」
In short, it seems Ms. Sasaki messed up and got chewed out by the current head of the Suzakuin family.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Ugh, I really just cannot get along with that guy！」

name: Iori
message: 「More importantly, what was that about flying through the sky...？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「W-Well, don't sweat the small stuff」
I knew it—this woman really isn't human, is she...

name: Mikoto
message: 「Setting that aside, a little matter for consultation just landed in my lap」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Word has it that Muragaki is head over heels for a certain student. So, what's the truth of the matter？」

name: Iori
message: 「Pffft—？！」
I sputter involuntarily.

name: Iori
message: 「Wh-Why would you know about something like that, Ms. Sasaki—！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hahaha, I am the homeroom teacher of Takamura Class, after all. I know everything that goes on in Takamura Class」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I have a powerful source of information」
...Ah, I get it. That's gotta be Asahi—it's definitely Asahi！

name: Iori
message: 「I-It's fine, I'll handle it appropriately」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You mean you'll appropriately have your way with her」

name: Iori
message: 「Like hell I would！」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm a teacher, you know. There's no way laying a hand on my own student would ever be acceptable！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I don't particularly see the issue. If you both have feelings for each other, there shouldn't be any problem」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, I have to treat all my students equally. I can't go playing favorites with one particular student」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hm？ Is there a problem with that？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I'd think having your way with the girl you like and treating everyone equally are perfectly compatible」

name: Iori
message: 「First of all, let's stop calling it 'having my way with her,' okay」
That said, Ms. Sasaki does have a point.
Keep work and personal life strictly separate—treat everyone equally in public while continuing the relationship in private.
As long as I can pull that off, balancing both is possible, and the only thing left is what everyone else thinks.

name: Iori
message: 「...Asahi actually said something to me before」

name: Iori
message: 「That I must have already noticed everyone harbors more than a certain level of affection for me」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course I understand, and in my heart, I've already settled on one person」

name: Iori
message: 「It's just, whether it's right to tell her... I'm still hesitating」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I see, so all that's left is a matter of timing」

name: Iori
message: 「I suppose so」
Even I don't know when that will be yet.

name: Mikoto
message: 「I'm glad to hear that. Well then, I think I'll be off」

name: Iori
message: 「Right, see you—」
Suddenly, I notice gazes fixed on me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Staaaaaaaaaaaaaaare...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Staaare...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufufufu」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I-Iorin...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That was quite the interesting conversation to overhear」
Everyone who had just finished a lap of running was eavesdropping on us.
Ah... wait, could this be...

name: Iori
message: 「S-Sasaki-sensei！ Don't tell me you set me up！？」
Sasaki-sensei grinned wickedly, gave a wave, and walked away.
Th-That womaaaaan！！！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「H-Hey, Sensei, when you said your heart's settled on one person, that means there's someone you like among us, right？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「We can take that as confirmed, right！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Who is it？ Hurry up and confess」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's me, right？ Hey, hey, Iorin！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh my, it looks like things are about to get serious」

name: Asahi
message: 「You managed to dodge the question neatly last time, but it's about time to give it up, Iori-sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, just give me a little more time...！」
I back away as everyone closes in on me.

name: Asahi
message: 「No, we can't wait any longer」

name: Asahi
message: 「If today doesn't work, then tomorrow; if tomorrow doesn't work, then the day after. I'll ask you every single day until you tell me.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'll chase you to the ends of the earth and question you for hours—dozens of hours, if I have to♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ooh, I'll help out with that too~♪」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you ever need the Kazamine family's power, just say the word. I'd be happy to lend a hand.」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-You're joking, right...？」
Everyone is getting more and more dead serious.

name: Momiji
message: 「You know~, leaving stuff like this all vague just gets us even more fired up.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, you're better off just spilling it already~」

name: Iori
message: 「I-Is that how it works? I had no idea.」
Realizing I'm actually starting to buy into that, I shake my head.
Even if that were true, this isn't something to boldly announce in front of everyone like this.
I should tell her properly when it's just the two of us.

name: Iori
message: 「...Ahh, sure is nice weather today. Perfect day for a run.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, guess I'll go for a quick jog too！」
With that, a full-on dash！！！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aah, Sensei's making a run for it！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, hold it right there！ Got no guts?！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, a test of stamina, is it... I won't lose！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, no way~, Sensei's crazy fast！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, catch me if you can!」
Sorry, but when it comes to stamina, I don't see myself losing to you guys.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Don't worry, if we all set up a perimeter, we're bound to catch him！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright~, let's make Kei-chan our control center and work together to catch Sensei！」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-You've gotta be kidding me...！？」
They've all teamed up against me.

name: Iori
message: 「Dammit, how did things end up like this！？」
It's true that my feelings are already set.
I understood well that everyone wanted to know about it, and that leaving it vague would be dishonest.
Probably before long, I'll have to reach a conclusion.

name: Iori
message: 「I get it, I get it already！ I'll definitely tell you！！」
I can't say for sure when.
Still, so I never end up being dishonest—that much, at least, I've sworn in my heart.
So please, until that time. Just a little longer――I want you to wait for me.
